claims_and_limits: Google was notified October 17, published bulletin October 23 and expanded affected services October 28.
Weakly generated keys of eight eMudhra subordinate CAs could be reconstructed, creating risk for unpatched TLS clients that trust them.
Google says its infrastructure was not breached and telemetry shows no exploitation against Google Cloud workloads.

visual.shared_motif: Amber certificate chain branching into separate software layers; an affected subordinate link is marked for distrust, without breach imagery.
visual.status: Conceptual trust-store map. No implication that Google Cloud infrastructure was compromised.
